title: EXP-027-R2 — Clean Replay: Button Component Recovery in a Self-Contained Designer Session
objective: Independently replay the accepted EXP-027 procedure on a new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab03`: establish or confirm a usable Mongoose workflow entirely before mutation, prove the target absent, create exactly one target Form, capture its untouched clean baseline, place exactly one native Toolbox Button, assign only Name=`FX_ButtonRecovery03`, record the exact property-grid Type label, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save, exactly one ordinary target Form-tab close, and exactly one same-Designer Form-menu recent-forms reopen, then verify that the same scoped Form recovers the component with Name=`FX_ButtonRecovery03` and the identical Type label. If every semantic postcondition reproduces with decisive evidence, classify the EXP-027 procedure replay_verified only for this tested User-scope self-contained close/reopen workflow.

acceptance_checks.description: Before mutation, evidence enumerates the controlled browser context, preserves any inherited dirty state untouched, performs at most one permitted pre-mutation session-establishment sequence if needed, proves a populated live Select Form result, visibly confirms User editing scope, shows Case Sensitive unchecked with a known-existing positive control, and proves zero case-insensitive Name matches for FX_ComponentRecoveryLab03.

Evidence proves exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form FX_ComponentRecoveryLab03 was created through the fresh-dialog Classic/BuildFromScratch procedure with Save Template visibly unchecked, and the loaded Form identity is Name=FX_ComponentRecoveryLab03, ScopeType=User, ScopeName=<current user>.
Before component placement, inspected evidence proves the target Form is clean and untouched and records the rendered canvas/component state without claiming complete component cardinality.

Exactly one native Toolbox Button creation operation is evidenced; only Name is assigned to FX_ButtonRecovery03; decisive property-grid/accessibility evidence records exact Name and exact visible Type label before Save, with no unrelated property mutation.
Exactly one ordinary Designer Save is evidenced; afterward the target is clean and the component still reports exact Name=FX_ButtonRecovery03 and the identical Type label recorded in AC-4.
Exactly one ordinary Form-tab close is evidenced; the target tab is gone, no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt appears, no explicit unload occurs, and the same Designer client remains active.

Exactly one reopen through the same Designer's Form-menu recent-forms entry is evidenced; the reopened Form has Name=FX_ComponentRecoveryLab03, ScopeType=User, matching ScopeName, clean state, recovered component Name=FX_ButtonRecovery03, and Type exactly equal to AC-4. If the recent-forms entry is unavailable or session establishment is required after mutation, the experiment stops blocked.

Final read-only audit shows exactly one case-insensitive Select Form Name match for FX_ComponentRecoveryLab03, reconciles exactly one Form creation, one Button creation, one Name assignment, one ordinary Save, one target close, and one recent-forms reopen, and proves repository changes are confined to the EXP-027-R2 record and evidence/EXP-027-R2/. If all prior checks pass, the EXP-027 procedure may be classified replay_verified with the same narrow non-claims.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261007-165419-NP63. Rationale: EXP-027 is the strongest immediately preceding result: all acceptance checks passed and the Button Name/Type recovery across one ordinary Save, one ordinary Form-tab close, and one same-Designer recent-forms reopen is classified observed only. The factory progression calls for an independent clean replay before promotion to replay_verified. Replaying EXP-027 on a fresh FX_ Form is smaller and better grounded than opening a new capability lane, and it avoids depending on the blocked EXP-026 lifecycle state because the replay retains EXP-027's self-contained pre-mutation session-establishment design.
